name: Plain
description: Support and helpdesk: API-first B2B customer support platform (threads, customers, help center) with full UI-API parity via GraphQL.
access_notes: All plans include a 7-day free trial with no credit card required; paid plans start at $35/seat/month. API keys are generated self-serve in Settings -> Machine Users with fine-grained permissions.
mcp_notes: Official vendor remote MCP server at mcp.plain.com/mcp (OAuth, 30 tools across threads/customers/tenants/help center/workspace). Composio also has a PLAIN toolkit (23 tools, API key auth).

evidence.note: API keys issued to Machine Users, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer plainApiKey_xxx'; fine-grained per-key permissions.
Single GraphQL endpoint core-api.uk.plain.com/graphql/v1; 'no limitations in what can be done via the API vs the UI'.
Plans from $35/seat/month, 7-day free trial, no credit card required — self-serve trial signup.
Webhook targets (up to 25 per workspace) deliver workspace events via HTTPS POST.
Official Plain MCP server at https://mcp.plain.com/mcp using OAuth with the user's existing Plain account.
Composio PLAIN toolkit: 23 tools, auth API_KEY.
